text_block_list.text:
After losing the match against Narita 
Brian, Mayano Top Gun realizes that Brian 
is looking at "something" beyond just the 
race results.

Wondering what lay beyond that gaze, 
Mayano Top Gun wished for a rematch to 
find out for herself.

However, after hearing from Hishi Amazon 
that Narita Brian likely intended to 
retire after the Arima Kinen, Mayano Top 
Gun—

She vows to grow into an Umamusume who can 
truly thrill her. To that end, she takes 
on the GⅠ race where powerful rivals 
gather: the Takarazuka Kinen!
